About the role:
Sun City Air Conditioning is seeking a Service Coordinator - Air Conditioning to join our growing team in Banyo, Queensland. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in ensuring the seamless coordination of our air conditioning service operations. As Service Coordinator, you will be the backbone of our service delivery team, managing schedules, customer communications, and administrative processes to keep our business running efficiently. This role is based on-site at our Banyo location and is essential to maintaining our reputation for excellent customer service and outcomes in the field.

Scheduling experience (although desirable) is not essential, however admin experience is a must:
- As important as your experience is, of more importance to us is your:
- Aptitude – you are bright and learn easily and quickly
- Attitude – we aim to be winners and want people on the team who enjoy succeeding
- Drive for self improvement - you must want to learn new things and continually strive to improve outcomes for yourself and the business

What you'll be doing:
- Scheduling and coordinating service appointments for technicians, ensuring optimal route planning and customer satisfaction
- Managing customer enquiries via phone, email and other communication channels with professionalism and responsiveness
- Maintaining accurate records of service calls, customer information and job details in our systems
- Liaising between customers, technicians and management to resolve issues and ensure smooth service delivery
- Processing payments and managing basic accounting tasks related to service operations
- Monitoring technician availability and managing staff schedules
- Following up with customers post-service to ensure satisfaction and gather feedback
- Supporting the team with general administrative duties as required

What we're looking for:
- Proven experience in an administrative support or coordination role, ideally within the trades, HVAC, or service-based industry
- Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks effectively
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional approach to customer interactions
- Proficiency with computer systems and office software, including email, spreadsheets and scheduling applications
- Ability to work independently whilst being a reliable team player who supports colleagues
- Problem-solving mindset with the capacity to handle customer concerns diplomatically
- Reliability and punctuality with a commitment to maintaining professional standards
- Basic knowledge of air conditioning systems or the HVAC industry is desirable but not essential, as training will be provided
- A valid driver's licence is advantageous

What we offer:
We offer a competitive salary package ($60-$85'k) commensurate with experience, along with a supportive and collaborative work environment. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills in the air conditioning and trades sector, working alongside experienced technicians and management. We value our team members and provide ongoing support to help you succeed in your role. We encourage a healthy work-life balance and provide a stable, full-time position with potential for career progression within our growing company.

About us:
Sun City Air Conditioning is a well-established business serving the Brisbane area with quality air conditioning services. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service and reliable, professional solutions for residential and commercial air conditioning needs. Our team is dedicated to maintaining high standards of workmanship and customer satisfaction. We are committed to supporting our employees and creating a workplace where teamwork and professionalism are valued.

IT Network Infrastructure contract with State Gov    Your new company     
 Join a large Queensland-based organisation responsible for delivering critical digital and ICT services that support public-facing operations across the state. With a strong focus on innovation, customer service, and digital transformation, the organisation manages complex technology environments that enable secure and reliable services for key government stakeholders. You'll be part of a collaborative team delivering meaningful outcomes that have a direct impact on communities throughout Queensland. 
  Your New Role  
 As Project Manager, you will lead the delivery of a statewide network infrastructure upgrade project, overseeing the replacement and commissioning of routers across multiple sites. Working within a complex ICT environment, you will be responsible for planning, scheduling, and coordinating all project activities to ensure successful delivery from initiation through to operational handover. 
 You will manage project governance, procurement activities, vendor coordination, stakeholder engagement, risk management, asset tracking, and financial oversight. The role will require close collaboration with internal teams, external suppliers, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure upgrades are completed efficiently, documented appropriately, and transitioned into ongoing support. You will also provide regular project status reporting, manage resources, and drive project outcomes in line with established project management methodologies and governance frameworks. 
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 
 Demonstrated experience delivering ICT infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, or technology upgrade projects. 
 Proven ability to lead project teams and manage project delivery across complex enterprise environments. 
 Experience managing project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, procurement activities, and vendor relationships. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Experience delivering projects involving network technologies such as routers, WAN/LAN environments, telecommunications infrastructure, or similar technologies. 
 Strong understanding of project governance frameworks and methodologies, including PRINCE2, Agile, PMBOK, or equivalent. 
 Ability to identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and maintain project momentum within changing environments. 
 Experience using Jira, Confluence, or other project management and collaboration tools will be highly regarded. 
 PRINCE2 certification or equivalent project management accreditation is desirable. 
 
  What You'll Get in Return  
 
 Opportunity to lead a significant ICT infrastructure project with statewide impact. 
 Brisbane CBD location with flexible working arrangements. 
 Exposure to complex enterprise networking and critical technology environments. 
 Collaborative and supportive team culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement. 
 Opportunity to work alongside experienced ICT, infrastructure, and project professionals.

About the Role

Based at our Clarendon Clinic, which is centrally located and close to multiple public transport routes, this is a great opportunity to increase your skills in community mental health. You will provide a high standard of clinical assessment, treatment and outreach support to clients of the St. Vincent's integrated adult MHS and their carers, demonstrating excellence in discipline specific and recovery-focused case management skills

You will join a dynamic Mobile Support Mental Health Team operating under a recovery-oriented model of care, utilising the Strengths Model of Case Management.

Work within the Strengths Model of recovery orientated practice

Provide a discipline specific service to consumers who are currently registered with the Clarendon Mobile Support Team

Assist with and undertake the assessment, provision of treatment and delivery of targeted interventions to consumers with complex mental health related needs and their family-carers in line with SVMH policies and strategic direction

Work a 7 day rotation roster

Classifications for this position will range from

RPN Grade 3 NP81 - NP74 ($107,546 - $119,438 per annum pro rata)

OT-SW Grade 3 YB24 - YB27 or YC46 - YC49 ($92,944 - $106,834 per annum pro rata)

Psychologist Grade 2 PK1 - PK4 ($94,478- $106,906 per annum pro rata)

Bachelor Degree in Occupational Therapy or Social Work

Clinical Masters in Psychology and current Registration as a Psychologist under the Health Professions Registration Act 2005 (Vic)

Division 3 or Division 1 Nurse with Psychiatric Endorsement from the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)

A minimum of at least 3 years post qualification within your profession, preferably within the mental health field

Experience in the provision of assessment, discipline specific intervention and case management services to consumers with a serious mental illness and complex needs and their carers within a recovery framework

Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills

Post-graduate qualifications in relevant area of specialty or in the process of achieving the same are desirable

Ability to join Fitness Passport - Your pass to an extensive choice of fitness facilities

Salary Packaging - Increase your take home pay!

Discounts and Promotions always available through our Foundation

Regular opportunities for professional development to assist you to reach your career goals

Culture of continuous improvement

St. Vincent's Mental Health (SVMH) includes an adult area mental health service for the inner city areas of Yarra and Boroondara.

About This Role:

Our client is a beloved artisan bakery renowned for its commitment to traditional baking techniques and high-quality, handcrafted products. With a passion for creating delicious, wholesome breads, pastries, and desserts, they take pride in using time-honoured methods and premium ingredients to deliver exceptional baked goods to their community.
We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Commis Cook to join their dedicated kitchen team. In this role, you will provide essential support in the preparation and production of high-quality baked goods and kitchen items, while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and food safety. The ideal candidate will have a strong work ethic, a keen willingness to learn, and a passion for the culinary arts.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Food Preparation & Kitchen Support:
· Assist in the preparation, measuring, and weighing of ingredients for breads, pastries, and other bakery items according to exact specifications.
· Perform basic food preparation tasks such as chopping, mixing, and shaping doughs under the guidance of senior kitchen staff.
· Support the monitoring of fermentation and proofing processes for optimal results.

Quality & Service Assistance:
· Help maintain consistent quality by following established recipes and procedures diligently.
· Assist with taste-testing preparations and ensure workstation is stocked and organised.
· Support the packaging and presentation of finished products as required.

Equipment & Workspace Maintenance:
· Conduct thorough cleaning and sanitizing of kitchen equipment, work areas, utensils, and baking trays to comply with health and safety regulations.
· Assist in the safe operation and basic maintenance of kitchen machinery and tools.
· Ensure proper storage of ingredients and adherence to stock rotation procedures.

Skills & Requirements:
· Proven 2 years’ full-time experience in related position, with a strong interest in baking/pastry. Bakery experience is highly advantageous.
· Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or above) is preferred.
· A foundational understanding of food preparation techniques and kitchen operations.
· Ability to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays as required in a bakery environment.
· Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality food.
· Strong understanding of food safety standards (HACCP) and hygiene best practices.
· Physical stamina to stand for long periods and work in a fast-paced, hot environment.

If you are passionate about food, eager to learn traditional baking techniques, and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional products with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.

We help people who have been involved in a car accident by handling all aspects of the claim from providing a replacement car to making sure their car is back on the road in no time.

The opportunity
We’re looking for a proven new-business sales professional who knows how to open doors, build influence, and win share with collision repairers, tow companies, vehicle dealerships and insurance brokers across Melbourne, Victoria.

If you already have strong relationships with repairers, dealers, or automotive referrers, and you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, get your hands dirty, and do what it takes to win and keep business, this role is built for you.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will own and grow the Victorian territory, with a primary focus on:
Winning new repairers, tow companies, dealers and insurance brokers
Expanding engagement with existing referrers
Driving sustained revenue growth through disciplined sales activity

This is a field-based, relationship-driven role where success comes from consistent prospecting, face-to-face engagement, and commercial follow-through.

You’ll plan and execute your own sales rhythm, identifying targets, booking visits, educating partners on our value proposition, and converting opportunities into long-term referrer relationships.

This role involves regular travel throughout Victoria to support new and existing accounts. From time to time, you will also travel outside Victoria to support national sales initiatives, key accounts, or strategic opportunities, working closely with the wider team. Importantly, this is not a “stay in the office” sales role. When needed, you will be on the ground supporting operations, including assisting customers, and helping resolve issues in real time. You see this as part of building trust, not someone else’s problem.

What you’ll be doing
Proactively hunting new business with collision repairers, tow companies, dealerships and insurance brokers
Leveraging existing industry relationships to accelerate growth
Building trusted partnerships through regular, structured visits
Positioning us as the preferred mobility partner
Managing your pipeline and activity through CRM with discipline and accuracy
Working closely with internal teams to deliver great outcomes for customers and partners
Travelling throughout Victoria, to support sales growth
Stepping in operationally where required – including customer interactions – to protect relationships and outcomes

What we’re looking for
This role will suit someone who is:
A true sales hunter with a track record of winning new business
Experienced selling into collision repairers, automotive dealerships, insurance brokers, or related automotive services
Well-connected in the Melbourne, Victoria repairer network (highly desirable)
Commercially minded, self-directed, and comfortable working autonomously
Practical, hands-on, and comfortable operating in the real world – not just from a CRM

You’ll also bring a valid driver’s licence with a solid driving record, a willingness to travel regularly as part of the role, strong organisational skills with disciplined follow-up, and a customer-first mindset with the resilience to confidently handle objections and complexity.

What’s in it for you
We believe in recognising great performance and supporting growth opportunities.

You’ll benefit from:
A competitive base salary with a competitive commission structure which is actually achievable, a company vehicle and fuel card
Career development and progression pathways within a growing business
A supportive leadership team that values initiative, results and empowers decision-making

Ready to drive your next chapter?
If you’re ready to lead, grow, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and take the wheel of your next great opportunity.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have customer service experience?
How many years' experience do you have as a Business to Business Business Development Manager?

result.description:
Bilco Modular is a Perth-based construction company with extensive expertise in delivering major commercial and residential building projects throughout Australia. Our portfolio spans diverse sectors, including mining camp facilities, holiday park developments, and various large-scale construction initiatives.

Position Description: Bilco Group is seeking a qualified Full time wall and floor tiler to work on residential and commercial projects.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Review and interpret building plans, drawings and specifications, and accurately measure, mark out and set up work areas before work begins.
•	Prepare wall and floor substrates by stripping away old grout, adhesive and other unsuitable materials, rectifying surface defects, and ensuring all surfaces are clean, sound and level ready for tile installation.
•	Apply waterproofing membranes and surface treatments where required.
•	Mix and spread adhesives, cement-based mortars and screeds onto prepared surfaces using the correct methods and techniques.
•	Lay and position tiles with precision, maintaining correct alignment, uniform spacing and a level finish.
•	Cut, shape and fit ceramic, porcelain, terrazzo, glass mosaic and natural stone tiles using hand and power tools, working neatly around edges, corners, fixtures, fittings and pipework.
•	Grout tile joints, then clean and polish completed surfaces to achieve the required finish.
•	Fit tile strips and trim sections to form decorative patterns and produce clean, professional edge detailing.
•	Check finished work against plans, quality expectations and applicable building codes to confirm compliance.
•	Keep the work site clean, safe and well organised at all times.
•	Communicate and coordinate effectively with site supervisors, project managers and other trades on site.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience Required:
•	Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling (or equivalent), or at least 3 years' full time relevant experience in lieu of the qualification.
•	At least One years' full time relevant experience, or 3 years' full time relevant experience if no relevant qualification is held.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
•	Sound knowledge of WHS requirements in construction
Job Type: Permanent Full time
Location: Denmark, WA
Salary: AUD 80,000 – AUD 90,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Role
As a Residential Care Officer, you will play a vital role in supporting older adults to live with dignity, comfort and choice. You’ll deliver compassionate, person-centred care in a welcoming community, working alongside a dedicated team that truly values respect, inclusion and quality of life. 

DUTIES:
• Keep resident documentation accurate and current, including daily notes, care assessments, and care plans.
• Monitor and record any changes in residents’ needs, promptly reporting concerns.
• Make residents’ beds and ensure fresh, clean linen is always available.
• Keep residents’ clothing stored neatly and organised.
• Correctly return laundered clothing to the appropriate residents’ rooms.
• Assist with meal service, supporting residents during mealtimes as needed.
• Help deliver specialised nursing care under supervision, following individual care plans.
• Provide consistently high standards of care and support to all residents.
• Encourage residents’ independence by assisting with personal care respectfully and in line with their care plan.
• Communicate effectively with colleagues, residents, families, GPs, and allied health professionals to ensure prompt, courteous service.
• Uphold residents’ rights to privacy, confidentiality, choice, and decision-making always.
• Offer emotional support and companionship to residents.
• Engage proactively and cooperatively as part of the wider care team.
• Build and nurture positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
• Support compliance with the Aged Care Standards and company policies.
• Remain adaptable and responsive to organisational needs and changes.
• Attend team meetings, training sessions, and mandatory education programs.
• Identify personal training needs and take part in ongoing learning.
• Contribute to workplace safety and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Recognise and report potential risks or complaints relevant to the role.
• Follow all Occupational Health & Safety (OH&S) policies and safe work practices.
• Take responsibility for maintaining a safe environment for yourself, your team, and residents.
• Adhere to all relevant legislation and workplace requirements.
• Demonstrate and promote Equal Employment Opportunity principles, ensuring a respectful, harassment-free workplace.
• Follow and champion all organisational policies and procedures.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:
• Up-to-date annual flu vaccination and full COVID-19 immunisation.
• Signed statutory declaration disclosing any serious overseas criminal history.
• Minimum 1-year relevant, full-time experience.
• Diploma/relevant qualification.
• Satisfactory police check.
• Valid driver’s licence and own transport.
• Team player with a genuine commitment to long-term employment.
• Current NDIS Worker Screening Clearance (within 5 years) Preferable.

Why You'll Love Working here:
• Rewarding work that makes a real difference in residents' lives
• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
• Supportive team culture with regular staff recognition
• Modern facilities with quality resources
• Career growth potential within our organization

How to Apply:
If you're passionate about quality residential aged care and meet the requirements, we'd love to hear from you!
*All successful applicants must comply with Aged Care Quality Standards and complete orientation training. *
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your experience and why you'd be perfect for this role.

Your new company     We're seeking an experienced Insurance Domain Architect to play a pivotal role in defining the future-state architecture across core insurance operations, data, reporting and business capabilities. This is a unique opportunity for an architect who combines deep insurance industry expertise with strong enterprise architecture capability and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders across multiple organisations.    Your new role     As the Insurance Domain Architect, you'll act as the architectural authority across insurance operations, ensuring business, regulatory and operational requirements are reflected in strategic technology decisions. Working closely with business leaders, architects, delivery partners and external stakeholders, you'll define target-state and transition architectures, drive governance outcomes and provide architectural leadership across a complex transformation environment. This role sits at the intersection of business and technology, making it ideal for an architect who enjoys influencing strategy, operating models, transformation roadmaps and enterprise-wide decision-making.   
 
 Define and maintain target-state and transition-state architectures across core insurance domains.
